description: This bar chart illustrates the difference in Average Word Error Rate (WER) from Whisper large for two models, NESAC ft model and SESHA ft model, across five different optimizations applied. The vertical axis represents the optimizations applied, labeled “Dates”, “Americanisms”, “Remove Spacing”, “Add Spacing”, and “Normalised”, listed in that order. The horizontal axis represents the difference in Average WER, with a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.0035, with tick labels at 0.000, 0.001, 0.002, and 0.003. For each optimization, there are two bars: an orange bar representing the NESAC ft model and a green bar representing the SESHA ft model. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each optimization. For “Dates”, the NESAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00257, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00228. For “Americanisms”, the NESAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00299, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00302. For “Remove Spacing”, the NESAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00311, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00306. For “Add Spacing”, the NESAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00319, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00344. For “Normalised”, the NESAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00334, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00323. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
